items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: he gave me a list of things that he wanted done.

ctx.x: And he said he'd never record unless he got exactly what he wanted, and that's exactly what happened on the session I gave him. Like I told you earlier in the tape, when we played the tapes back, I says, Tom, what do you think of me? He says, exactly what I wanted.
I remember, I'm not trying to give any secrets right, but I think Eden had one of the agreements is the publicity and what went on, all the companies and everything. Oh yeah, he wanted,
he gave me a list of things that he wanted done.
